title: Chicken Biryani

steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Today we are cooking fragrant chicken biryani!
Wash your hands first. Remember that hot stoves and deep pots must be handled by a grown-up.
Look at our fragrant basmati rice, tender chicken pieces, sliced onions, and golden spices.
Add the sliced onions into our warm cooking pot and saute until golden brown.
Carefully add the chicken pieces with the warm aromatic spices into the pot.
Stir everything together so the spices coat all the chicken with wonderful flavor.
Gently layer the long grain basmati rice right over our spiced chicken.
Cover the pot and let the biryani steam gently until the rice is fluffy and tender.
Spoon the steaming chicken biryani onto our serving plate. It smells incredible!
